lines.trans: I need to save up some money first.
I need to buy a ring and book a restaurant.
I will tell you one secret right now.
Back home we sometimes steal the bride.
It is almost like an application, only more fun.
And later you save money for the wedding together.

examples.text: Я вас видел, кажется.
examples.trans: I think I've seen you.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'she', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Ты видел, она даже не тронула!
examples.trans: Did you see, she did not even touch it!

examples.text: Это наше старинное национальное домашнее блюдо.
examples.trans: This is our traditional national homemade dish.

examples.text: Ну конечно, она давно ждёт свадьбу.
examples.trans: Well of course, she has been waiting for a wedding for a long time.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'between', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Тебе нужно выбрать между двумя парнями.
examples.trans: You need to choose between two guys.

examples.text: Кажется, она сейчас между вами выбирает.
examples.trans: It seems she is choosing between you two right now.

examples.text: Кому ещё нужно выбирать между вами?
examples.trans: Who else needs to choose between you two?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'you', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Ты согласилась выйти замуж за Никиту?
examples.trans: Did you agree to marry Nikita?

examples.text: Привет, девочки, о чём вы шепчетесь?
examples.trans: Hello, girls, what are you whispering about?

examples.text: Давай запустим оттуда красивый свадебный салют.
examples.trans: Let us launch a beautiful wedding fireworks display from there.

meanings.note: Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'бирать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'chooses'.

examples.text: Кажется, она сейчас между вами выбирает.
examples.trans: It seems she is choosing between you two right now.

examples.text: Кому ещё нужно выбирать между вами?
examples.trans: Who else needs to choose between you two?

examples.text: Может, Костя выбирает себе лучшего друга.
examples.trans: Maybe Kostya is choosing a best friend for himself.

meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'смотреть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'look', paired with 'смотреть'.

examples.text: Можно я посмотрю?
examples.trans: May I have a look?

examples.text: Я только посмотрел.
examples.trans: I only had a look.

examples.text: А можно я пойду посмотрю?
examples.trans: Can I go and have a look?

meanings.note: Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'ужели').

examples.text: Посмотри, неужели у меня большие уши?
examples.trans: Look, do I really have big ears?

examples.text: Неужели так трудно найти хороший сюжет?
examples.trans: Is it really so difficult to find a good story?

examples.text: Неужели президент накажет вас за правду?
examples.trans: Will the president really punish you for the truth?

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('big').

examples.text: Посмотри, какой большой кусок хорошего мяса.
examples.trans: Look what a big piece of good meat.

examples.text: Нет, шеф, мы больше не будем.
examples.trans: No, chef, we will not do it anymore.

examples.text: Хорошо, тогда большое спасибо за помощь.
examples.trans: Good, then thank you very much for your help.

meanings.note: Common neuter noun meaning 'ears' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Уходите, я всё сам сегодня приготовлю.
examples.trans: Go away, I will cook everything myself today.

examples.text: Я тебе сейчас отрежу ухо!
examples.trans: I'm going to cut off your ear right now!

examples.text: У меня болит ухо.
examples.trans: My ear hurts.
